Name: Murad Rapid Relief Acne Spot Treatment
Natural: Discover a fast-acting blemish gel with the Murad Rapid Relief Acne Spot Treatment; a maximum-strength formula that seeks to reduce the appearance of blemishes within four hours*. Ideal for both day and night time, the invisible gel is able to be applied with or without makeup. The treatment is enriched with Salicylic Acid, which performs an exfoliating action on skin. This works in synergy with Horse Chestnut and Oat Extracts to balance and soothe the complexion, therefore treating the blemish and reducing the appearance of redness. Ideal for those with acne-prone skin or during an occasional breakout, simply apply the formula to the blemish and experience rapid results. *Based on a Murad sponsored study.
